== Summary ==
Cropped distribution copy of the Decipher card face for [[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins]].

The 490 × 350 pixel image is the exact RGB crop (3, 3)–(493, 353) of [[:File:ANH-L-yavin4massassiruins-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher’s complete 506 × 367 pixel image]], with the outer drop shadow removed. The printed text, artwork, icons, frame and copyright line are pixel-identical.<ref name="decipher-cropped-copy">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030105093040id_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/images/yavin4massassiruins.gif original Decipher card-list image] (complete GIF, SHA-1 <code>e1e3b0a9eaa558f31f24c3867f424351ae66e270</code>) and [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/large/yavin4massassiruins.gif Players Committee Holotable distribution copy] (SHA-1 <code>104e8e2c9378751ed680a8b993eef258698f56ec</code>).</ref>

The copy is hosted in the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/large/yavin4massassiruins.gif Players Committee Holotable distribution copy].
